notes.title: DLC and Deluxe Bundle Now Available
notes.content:
The DLC  for Gray Skies, Dark Waters (which includes the soundtrack + an art book detailing the decisions that went into making the game's aesthetic) is now available, as is a deluxe edition that includes both the DLC and the base game! Get the soundtrack/art book for 15% off - that's $1.69 - or the bundle for 8% off, or $8.25. 

Thanks to everyone who's supported us so far by played the game. We're so pleased to continue sharing our work with you!

- the Green Willow Games team
